workstreams.currentContract: Own shared encoding, density metadata, paths, fonts, policies, save behavior, production batch controls, raster safety, image projection, chart primitives, diagnostics, and visual-quality helpers.
workstreams.boundary: Document packages retain source semantics; bounded codec variants and managed text-shaping approximations remain diagnosed explicitly.

workstreams.currentContract: Export worksheet content to PNG and SVG through Excel-owned layout semantics and Drawing-owned rendering primitives.
workstreams.boundary: Complex comments, conditional icons, pattern fills, rich text, sparklines, stacked text, shape text, charts, images, objects, and page slicing have explicit fidelity diagnostics and evidence limits.

workstreams.currentContract: Export fixed-size authored and imported slides through the native presentation renderer with PNG and SVG evidence.
workstreams.boundary: Placeholder and master inheritance, grouped objects, connectors, charts, tables, and unsupported content retain explicit fidelity boundaries.

workstreams.currentContract: Export estimated multi-page Word layouts while keeping Word-owned wrapping, sections, fields, and object anchoring separate from Drawing-owned pixels and vectors.
workstreams.boundary: The renderer does not claim Microsoft Word application pagination; overflow, fallback, and estimated-pagination behavior is diagnosed.

workstreams.currentContract: Render continuous and paged HTML output through the shared five-format image API, with explicit Email.Image and Epub.Image bridges for their source models.
workstreams.boundary: HTML owns layout and resource semantics while Drawing owns reusable raster and SVG encoding.

workstreams.currentContract: Export OneNote pages, sections, notebooks, ink, math, images, and selections through the shared converter result contract.
workstreams.boundary: OneNote retains package semantics while Drawing owns pixels, vectors, encoders, bounded raster diagnostics, and naming behavior.

workstreams.currentContract: Export Visio pages and document batches to PNG, JPEG, TIFF, SVG, and WebP through native Visio geometry and shared encoding contracts.
workstreams.boundary: Loaded stencil artwork, connectors, text, themes, unsupported shapes, and supersampled raster allocation retain explicit evidence and budget limits.

workstreams.currentContract: Render OfficeIMO-generated and bounded arbitrary-producer PDF pages through first-party PDF-to-Drawing operators with shared format, selection, safety, and diagnostic contracts.
workstreams.boundary: Arbitrary-producer operators, fonts, images, transparency, forms, annotations, and missing authored appearance streams are supported conservatively and diagnosed.

workstreams.currentContract: Provide Drawing-backed PNG decode, encode, and difference evidence with changed-area, MAE, RMSE, luminance, renderability, and nonblank checks.
workstreams.boundary: Desktop applications, Poppler, and other reference tools are optional test or manual-review dependencies and never product rendering dependencies.
